🔥 5+ CRORE CASES PENDING. INDIA NEEDS A NEW PATH TO JUSTICE.

India cannot litigate its way out of every dispute.

Behind every pending case is a human story.

A family waiting for peace.
A child caught in conflict.
A business waiting for closure.
A relationship waiting for dignity.
A person waiting years to move forward.

With 5+ crore cases pending across India’s courts, we must ask a bigger question:

Can we build a culture where disputes are resolved before they become endless battles?

At MEDARB International, we believe the answer lies in creating a stronger ecosystem around:

MEDIATION FIRST. ARBITRATION FOR CLOSURE.

🤝 MEDIATION FIRST

Not every dispute needs a courtroom battle.

Mediation creates a confidential environment for dialogue, negotiation, understanding and mutually acceptable solutions—while protecting relationships and dignity.

⚖️ ARBITRATION FOR CLOSURE

Where parties have agreed to arbitrate and mediation does not resolve the dispute, arbitration can provide a structured, private and binding route to closure.

Especially in family disputes, winning should not be the only objective.

The real objective is to:

• Preserve dignity
• Protect children from prolonged conflict
• Enable constructive co-parenting
• Resolve financial and property disputes
• Reduce destructive confrontation
• Help families move forward

🌍 BUILDING A MOVEMENT, NOT JUST A PROGRAM

MEDARB International is taking Med-Arb beyond traditional professional platforms.

🎓 COLLEGES & UNIVERSITIES
Creating awareness and empowering the next generation of ADR professionals.

⚖️ MEDIATION CLINICS
Taking accessible dispute resolution closer to families and communities.

🌐 WEBINARS & MASTERCLASSES
Connecting lawyers, mediators, arbitrators, academics and professionals with contemporary ADR knowledge.

🌍 GLOBAL SYMPOSIUMS
Bringing international perspectives, experts and best practices to the Indian ADR ecosystem.

🏆DUAL CERTIFICATION
Developing professionals equipped with competencies in both mediation and arbitration.

OUR VISION

Fewer disputes becoming battles.
More disputes becoming conversations.
More conversations becoming settlements.
More settlements becoming new beginnings.

We are not merely creating another training platform.

We are building a culture of resolution.

Because:

Litigation may determine a winner.
Mediation creates possibilities.
Arbitration can provide closure.
Med-Arb creates a structured pathway between the two.

🌎 THE FUTURE OF JUSTICE MUST ALSO BE THE FUTURE OF RESOLUTION.

Let us move from:

Conflict → Conversation
Confrontation → Collaboration
Delay → Resolution
Disputes → New Beginnings

MedArb International

Mediation First. Arbitration for Closure.Dignity Always.
